accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure text color #1F2937 is used on light backgrounds. Use #FFFFFF on primary buttons.
accessibility.focus_states: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2D4A3E]/50
accessibility.aria_labels: Required for all icon-only buttons and complex interactive components.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPERATIVE: Use the 'Fraunces' font for all headings (h1-h3) and 'Manrope' for body text.
IMPERATIVE: Do not use pure black (#000000). Use the dark charcoal (#1F2937) provided.
IMPERATIVE: Implement the 'Tetris' grid layout for the landing page as described in layout_strategies.
IMPERATIVE: Ensure all forms use the 'inputs.base' style defined in components.
IMPERATIVE: The 'Voice' aspect is central. Use the 'pulse_slow' animation on microphone icons or active states.
IMPERATIVE: For the 'Role Selection' screen, use large, clickable cards with the 'cards.feature' style.
IMPERATIVE: Use the provided image URLs for their respective sections. Do not use placeholders.
IMPERATIVE: For the dashboard, strictly follow the 'bento_grid' layout.
IMPERATIVE: Authentication pages (Login/Register) must look professional and secure, using the 'cards.base' style centered on screen.
IMPERATIVE: The 'Medical Disclaimer' must be visible but unobtrusive (text-xs text-muted-foreground) in the footer.
IMPERATIVE: Use 'sonner' for all toast notifications.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
